title: The Enchained Spiritual Beast Ga-Rei
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: High schooler Kensuke Nimura can see spirits, and after a chance meeting with Kagura Tsuchimiya, who commands a spirit-devouring beast called Byakuei for a secret government agency, he is drawn into fighting evil spirits. Their battles against Kagura's former best friend Yomi, rival exorcist clans and a nine-tailed fox spirit escalate to the destruction of central Tokyo. In the end Kagura stands by Yomi despite everyone's opposition, Yomi gives herself to save Kagura, and the survivors live together and continue their exorcism work.
life_message: Steadfast loyalty to friends, even friends who have fallen, can save them and the world.
